predictions.registered: 2026-11-22 (before any Exp125 solver code or numerical run)
predictions.question: Close Risk R7 (1.50 T homogeneous sample field vs <=0.4 T superconducting NbTiN resonator plane with |B_perp|<=10 mT) via exact axisymmetric Biot-Savart multi-coil superconducting magnet + active bucking coil + coupled Nb Meissner shield BEM + Cryoperm jacket; unify the 5-stage cryogenic thermal (50K/4K/Still/CP/MXC 20 mK vs 1 K) + RF SNR + throughput solver across 56-82 readout chains; and close Risk R8 by adding physical phase-sensitive silicon valley interference (cos(k0*R) on Si diamond lattice) and narrow tunnel-coupling window sensitivity to Exp118's 1 K ancilla-yield model.

method.magnet_r7: Exact circular-filament Biot-Savart (Bz, Br, A_phi) using scipy.special.ellipk/ellipe with 2D Gauss-Legendre quadrature over finite rectangular coil cross-sections (quadrature convergence verified across 4x4, 8x8, 12x12, 16x16). Coupled axisymmetric Boundary Element Method (BEM) enforcing zero total magnetic flux (Phi_total = 0, ZFC Meissner condition) on an open-port Nb superconducting cup housing the NbTiN resonator carrier, validated against the analytical superconducting sphere benchmark (internal B=0, equatorial B=1.5*B0) and BEM mesh convergence (M=80..320). Multi-coil currents optimized via constrained least-squares / SLSQP to satisfy Bz(0,0)=1.5000 T, <100 ppm homogeneity on r<=2.3 mm |z|<=0.5 mm, unshielded |B_surf|<B_c1(Nb,4.2K)=135 mT on the Nb shield exterior, and shielded |B_res|<=0.25 T and |B_perp|<=10 mT across the resonator carrier zone (r<=25 mm, dz=+-3 mm). Bottura (2000) NbTi Jc(B,4.2K) critical current surface (Cu:SC=2:1, packing 0.70), exact inductance matrix L_ij stored energy cross-checked vs volumetric int(B^2/2mu0 dV), Lorentz hoop stress sigma_hoop and axial force Fz, and adiabatic quench hot-spot T_hot.
method.cryo_rf_throughput: 5-stage cryogenic heat balance (50K, 4K, Still 0.88K, CP 100mK, MXC 20mK) anchored to Krinner et al. (arXiv:1806.07862 Table 2), Cryomech PT410/415/420, Rebelo (2026) 2.1 mW InP HEMT, LNF-LNC4_8C 10.5 mW, plus explicit persistent-mode magnet lead, 4K cryo-CMOS, and radiative/structural budgets across NL in [110, 163] (56-82 chains) comparing 20 mK Elzerman baseline (S6.8=D) vs 1 K hot-readout PSB (S6.8=C). Baseline replication gate against Exp110 (NL=58 -> 5.238 uW / 1.482 W) and Exp112 (NL=163 -> 0.230/0.549 W). RF dispersive readout SNR budget at -100 dBm/tone, Ql=800-1200, T_LNA=1.4-3.0 K, and end-to-end daily certified-register throughput.
method.ancilla_r8: 200k-trial Monte Carlo extending Exp118 (Exp92 BCA 5 keV straggle sigma_lat=3.25 nm, Rp=6.46+-2.88 nm, House et al. 2015 anchor tc_ref=1 GHz @20 nm). Replication gate reproduces Exp118 logU baseline. Adds two physical phase-sensitive silicon valley interference models on discrete Si diamond lattice (a_Si=0.5431 nm, k0=0.85*2pi/a_Si=9.834 nm^-1): V1 interface 2-valley |cos(k0*z+phi)| and V2 6-valley Koiller bulk |cos(k0*x)+cos(k0*y)+cos(k0*z)|/3, swept across bare tc window width {1,2,3,4} decades, gate tunability G in {1,3,10,30,100}, and Bohr decay lambda in {1.5,2.0,2.5} nm, computing p_yield, N99, oversampling cost delta, and break-even yield p_crit against S6.8=D (golden=0.5215).

predictions.success_rule: CV1 and CV2 and CV3 and CV4 and CV5 and CV6 all PASS (complete numerical closure of R7 magnet/shield, 5-stage cryo/RF budget, and R8 phase-sensitive valley lower bound).
predictions: CV1 SAMPLE HOMOGENEITY: Coupled multi-coil + Nb Meissner shield achieves Bz(0,0)=1.5000 T with max relative inhomogeneity < 1e-4 (100 ppm) over active chip zone r<=2.3 mm, |z|<=0.5 mm, and quadrature/BEM convergence error < 1e-5.

CV2 RESONATOR QUIET ZONE: Unshielded field on Nb shield outer surface stays strictly below B_c1(Nb,4.2K)=135 mT (vortex-free Meissner regime) and <= 0.25 T; inside the open-port Nb Meissner cup over r<=25 mm, dz=+-3 mm, max |B_res| <= 0.05 T (<<0.25 T) AND max |B_perp| <= 10 mT for BOTH horizontal (|Bz|) and vertical (|Br|) resonator orientations.

CV3 MAGNET ENGINEERING: Every coil operates at I_op/I_c(B_peak, 4.2K) <= 0.55; inductance-matrix E_mag matches volumetric integral int(B^2/2mu0 dV) within <= 2.5%; max Lorentz hoop stress |sigma_hoop| <= 80 MPa; adiabatic quench T_hot <= 150 K at dump voltage <= 500 V.

CV4 5-STAGE CRYO CLOSURE: Replication gate matches Exp110/112 readout loads to <1e-9; at NL=160-163 (56-57 lines, 2.1-7.8 mW HEMT) with magnet leads + cryo-CMOS + structural loads included, baseline 20 mK stage stays <19 uW MXC, <200 uW CP, <40 mW Still, <1.0 W 4K (single PT410), <40 W 50K; and 1 K hot-readout stays <100 mW at 1 K and <1.0 W at 4 K.
CV5 RF SNR MARGIN: At P_tone=-100 dBm, Ql=800-1200, T_LNA=1.4-3.0 K, insertion loss 1.5 dB, |Delta_Gamma|=0.05, RF integration time for SNR=10 is <= 10 ms (<< t_eff=1.445 s) for both 20 mK and 1.5 K.

CV6 RISK R8 VALLEY BOUND: Exp118 legacy baseline replicates within <0.005; under physical phase-sensitive valley interference (V1 & V2), generous Exp118 window (4 dec, G=100) keeps p_yield >= 0.90 (N99 <= 2), realistic moderate window (2 dec, G=10) lands in [0.60, 0.96], and tight window (1 dec, G=3) drops < 0.65, establishing the exact break-even yield p_crit vs S6.8=D.
